conflicts.reason: Explorers has no longest route for a caravan to double, so caravan scoring has nothing to measure.
Fishermen and Explorers can only be combined by rewriting three of the five fish spends, which Costanio has not built.
Explorers has no harbours, so there would be nothing to score.
Explorers and Islands both use ships and a pirate, and their rules for both are different.
Raiders needs a fixed coastline to land on and a castle to defend, and most of an Explorers map is face down when the game starts.
Explorers deals its map face down, so a river cannot be laid across it.
Explorers is not a land connected map, so a wagon has no route to travel.
Wagons cannot cross water, and an island board has no single landmass for the trade route to circle.

warnings.reason: Wagons removes the Longest Road award, so the camels' road bonus does nothing (their settlement points still score).
